c105769778.notes: Yellow-green hotel board on a pole in a traffic island, Angoche (Nampula). Only the title is legible at 1600 px; the small description, address ('Avenida da Liberdade, Angoche') and phone lines are not reliably readable. Distractors: the white 'GUEST HOUSE HESADA' board below and the yellow cut-out stencil town sign 'ANGOCHE' on the bench (stencil letters, the N and H render as solid blocks), plus a partly hidden 'SEJA BEM VINDO' bench. Alternative query: 'Angoche' (place).
